name: Shell Command Basics
description: Learn to use shell commands for file operations and data processing.

tasks.description: Use shell commands (not write_file) to create a file called shell_test.txt with content 'Created via shell'. Then use another command to display its contents.
tasks.expected_outcome: shell_test.txt exists with the correct content

tasks.description: Create a file named poem.txt with at least 20 words of text. Use a shell command to count the words and write just the count to wordcount.txt.
tasks.expected_outcome: poem.txt exists and wordcount.txt contains a number

tasks.description:
Create a file named data.csv with these lines: 'name,age
Alice,30
Bob,25
Charlie,35'. Use a shell command to sort the lines (excluding header) by age and write the sorted result to sorted.csv.
tasks.expected_outcome: sorted.csv exists with data sorted by age
